propositions: A focused prerequisite-consistency criterion must route only through the preloaded PlanRelationSnapshot, evaluate each readable pinned prerequisite independently against the subject plan, and emit closed-schema PrerequisiteCoverageOutput records with disposition consistent|finding|indeterminate and no cross-prerequisite findings.

General finder/verifier/coach requests must be isolated from prerequisite IDs and plan text; only the two focused prerequisite prompts receive prerequisite material, enforced by captured-string absence assertions.

Focused Pass-1 and Pass-2 must use separate non-overlapping index domains from general findings; each domain is independently reshaped and decided, then concatenated before the single shared execution-aware Pass-3 pipeline.

Any indeterminate prerequisite record forces top-level unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict while retaining DET blockers visibly in the blocking array; concurrent indeterminate-prerequisite and DET-blocker states both flow through to the unsigned verdict.

Prerequisite-scoped findings use a canonical length-prefixed structured identity (version|finding|criteria|prerequisite_id), while all non-prerequisite findings retain the legacy pipe-delimited encoding byte-for-byte; identical text from different prerequisites produces distinct IDs.

Singleton focused finder execution must achieve recall≥0.90, false-acceptance≤0.10, coverage=1.00, attribution-error=0.00 before packed batching; packed batching must maintain singleton thresholds or better; both phases are one atomic non-releasable delivery with a fail-fast internal checkpoint.
